literature.heading: Where the new notes contradict or update v6 and v7

od1_notes: 2023 enters TRAIN partly selected: TRAIN statistics on 2023 flatter the incumbent by up to about .08 in a paired difference [est].
2024 stays hidden but is not pristine. Only 2025 and later has never been read.
Four years cut every Sharpe standard error by 13% against three years; a true +.08 step has t .80, so v8 tests bundles and one cumulative comparison.
The standing rule never to read a per-candidate validation statistic no longer covers 2023. It covers 2024 and later.

paragraphs: **Thesis.** A dollar- and price-risk-neutral US equity long/short book, costed at $1bn with square-root impact and tiered borrow (scenario S2). v8 re-based the protocol on the four-year TRAIN window 2020-2023, corrected the baseline for delisting returns and the flat start (B0c), and tested a pre-registered, ordered list of construction cells, each against the last accepted cell.

**Interim result on TRAIN (owner stop, 2026-10-02).** Seven cells ran and are ledgered: B0a, B0b, the baseline B0c, R-1 (composition at matched gross) and R-2 (library v8.0), both accepted, and R-3 and R-4, not accepted. The book of this report is R-2, the last accepted cell: S2 net Sharpe {summ.net_sharpe|+.3f} against B0c's {@v8-b0c-dlret-ws60-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.net_sharpe|+.3f}, at all-rows gross leverage {summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} (B0c {@v8-b0c-dlret-ws60-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f}) and daily turnover {summ.tau_gmv_mean|.4f} of GMV (B0c {@v8-b0c-dlret-ws60-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.tau_gmv_mean|.4f}). No cumulative test of R-2 against B0c exists and the freeze gate is not evaluated: the differences are arithmetic, each accepted step is sign-level evidence.
check: The freeze gate reads the cell-count DSR (N = the ledger count, OD-4), never the effective-N figure.
Single cells are sign-level evidence; only the cumulative test V8-F vs B0c has power (plan 12.2).
Every figure is TRAIN 2020-2023; no statistic dated 2024-01-01 or later exists in this report.

paragraphs: Every number in this pitch is TRAIN 2020-2023. The report refuses any input whose path or content is dated on or after the seal, and every file it read is listed with its SHA-256 in the appendix.

The cells run in the pre-registered order (v8-prereg item 11). A cell is accepted when its paired S2 net dSR against its parent is above 0 AND mechanics pass AND the mechanical criterion named in its task holds (item 5); a rejected cell is not retried with other parameters. The year table shows whether a result rests on one year; 2023 is partly selected (OD-1).

The diagnostics G-1..G-3 ran on B0c, the v8 baseline, and cost no trial; they were not re-run on R-2. They, and the member columns ic_theta, f_theta and marginal IC of R-2's library below, gate nothing and select nothing (v8-prereg item 8): they explain the book, they do not choose it. The diagnostics file was assembled copy-only from the eight split runs of cells batch 1b (its assembled_from record names each source and its SHA-256).
The v8 literature review reversed or updated several v6 and v7 recommendations. The table lists each case with its source; the figures are from the literature, not measurements on the book.

The v7 pitch's book-level sections, run on R-2 (library v8.0, the last accepted cell; the interim book) over TRAIN 2020-2023: equity curve, drawdowns, returns, costs and turnover, capacity, exposures and signal correlation, then the v7 pitch's alpha-library figures on library v8.0. Each section checks every file it reads first and names the one it lacks. V8-F is pending: these are the figures of the last accepted cell, not of a frozen book.

interim.title: Interim status (owner stop, 2026-10-02; Ruling PM6-11)
items: **This is an interim report.** Its book (headline, section 5) is R-2 (library v8.0, spec lib-v80.json), the last accepted cell of the ladder; B0c is the v8 baseline.

**No cumulative test and no freeze gate yet.** The cumulative paired test V8-F against B0c and the freeze gate (v8-prereg item 9) are not evaluated, so no improvement over B0c is claimed as tested; the headline differences are arithmetic.

**Gains are sign-level per cell** (plan 12.2): the one-sided bootstrap p of each paired S2 net dSR against its parent is R-1 {j:r1.paired.lw.p_one_sided|.4f} (dSR {j:r1.paired.dsr|+.4f}), R-2 {j:r2.paired.lw.p_one_sided|.4f} (dSR {j:r2.paired.dsr|+.4f}), R-3 {j:r3.paired.lw.p_one_sided|.4f} (dSR {j:r3.paired.dsr|+.4f}), R-4 {j:r4.paired.lw.p_one_sided|.4f} (dSR {j:r4.paired.dsr|+.4f}). R-1 and R-2 were accepted (dSR > 0, mechanics and criterion), R-3 and R-4 were not.

**Gross is matched to the parent (Ruling PM6-6).** From R-1 on, each construction cell runs at the aim leverage L that puts its all-rows gross within .005 of its parent's. L by cell (summary.json): B0a {@v8-b0a-lo1-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g} / B0b {@v8-b0b-lo3-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g} / B0c {@v8-b0c-dlret-ws60-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g} / R-1 {@v8-r1-std-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.1474:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g} / R-2 {@v8-r1-std-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.1474-v80:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g} / R-3 {@v8-r3-aim-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.1264:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g} / R-4 {@v8-r4-hb.1-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:scen.construction.v5.aim_leverage|g}; all-rows gross (nav_summ): B0a {@v8-b0a-lo1-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} / B0b {@v8-b0b-lo3-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} / B0c {@v8-b0c-dlret-ws60-v71-ew-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} / R-1 {@v8-r1-std-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.1474:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} / R-2 {@v8-r1-std-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.1474-v80:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} / R-3 {@v8-r3-aim-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.1264:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f} / R-4 {@v8-r4-hb.1-t.05-d.1-fixed-obdelta-x.05-loc-L1.247:summ.mean_gross_leverage_all_rows|.4f}. R-4's directory name keeps the template's "L1.247" text; the L it ran at is the one above.

The deflated Sharpe is not meaningful yet: its pre-registered cross-trial variance rests on the v8 cells only until the registered re-runs of the v7 cells on the four-year window are done (Ruling PM5-22).

Trial accounting: TRAIN construction cells N {a:v8_ledger.n|d}; admission trials this sprint {a:v8_ledger.k|d} plus {a:v8_ledger.re_screens|d} re-screens; history reads 0; hidden 2024+ unread in this sprint (section 1).
The diagnostics G-1..G-3 (section 3) exist for B0c only and are labelled B0c. The cells not run are named once, under the cell ladder (section 2).

capacity_r2.title: Capacity curve of R-2 (E-29: report only, gates nothing)
items: Ruling PM4-5: the capacity books scale only the impact law (m^0.5) and the participation cap (1/m); the aim is the $1bn book's at every multiple, so the 2x and 4x rows are slightly optimistic on the aim cap.

The curve and the S2-KO / S2-FIM books come from a report-only re-run of R-2's NAV argv with --cost-v2 (build-equity/mega-nav-v8-r2-v80-stress); its S2 book is R-2's bit for bit (integration-log.md, interim report render 3).

planning.title: Planning value (for sizing and expectations; an estimate, not a forecast)
items: Plan on a live net Sharpe .7 to 1.0 [est] against the TRAIN figure {summ.net_sharpe|+.3f} (S2, 2020-2023, R-2: the interim book; V8-F pending).

Why lower than TRAIN: selection over N = {a:v8_ledger.n|d} ledgered construction trials, a 2023 that was read twice before it entered TRAIN (OD-1), and costs and borrow the model does not see (diagnostic G-3a).
No out-of-sample statistic exists for v8; 2024 and later stays sealed.

caveats.title: Honest caveats
items: **2023 is partly selected.** It was read twice at book level as validation before it entered TRAIN; TRAIN statistics on 2023 flatter the incumbent by up to about .08 in a paired difference [est].
**Power.** At four years a true +.08 step has t about .80; each single cell is sign-level evidence.
**Trials.** TRAIN construction cells N = {a:v8_ledger.n|d}; admission trials this sprint {a:v8_ledger.k|d} plus {a:v8_ledger.re_screens|d} re-screens (ruling R2-e).
**If the freeze gate is unmet** the lever is OD-3 (history 2013-2019 read once on the frozen book), not more cells on 2020-2023.
